name: uaap-baseline-policy
description: Fail-closed baseline policy. Evaluated as an AND-gate AFTER the Authorization Kernel. First matching rule wins; if none match, the request is denied.

rules.description: The prohibited baseline action class is always denied.
Active and elevated work against PRODUCTION is denied by baseline policy; it requires a dedicated, approved production policy overlay.
Passive (R0) public/metadata analysis is permitted in any mode once the kernel has cleared it.
Low-impact (R1) assurance work is permitted for the core assurance domains in non-production environments.
Elevated (R2) assurance work is permitted in non-production environments. The kernel still requires a per-action human approval token for R2.
